description:
## Notes

- Standing rules: CHECK PRIOR ART before any approach (fff / Prior Art dir); WWWWH-first copy; user-story template. Worktree agents: verify base vs main HEAD after spawn; uncommitted specs must be read from primary tree by absolute path.

- Tickets carry label map:studio-ux-overhaul. Claim (assignee + in_progress) before work. Frontier: sd ready. Conventions: docs/agents/issue-tracker.md. Glossary: CONTEXT.md.

## Decisions so far

- Navigation model: routable views and the overview skip (Archie-02ae) — place-addressable URLs (library/slug/slug+objectId), Overview mandatory (skip removed), push-on-every-place-change, nearest-ancestor fallback + notice, web bare URL=home vs desktop restore-last-place, session-only transient restore; ADR-0024.
- One save vocabulary (Archie-0b7b) — single end-to-end safety state (Failed > Action needed > Saving > Saved) over autosave+binding mirror; editor Save button dies, ⌘S = flush-now, indicator is the control when action needed; "Save" reserved for the one non-automatic act; CONTEXT.md → Persistence.

- Where the narrative is edited (Archie-da38) — ADR-0016 §56 upheld (beats authored on canvas, overview spine read-only); friction fixed by beat deep links from spine rows (impl Archie-696d, blocked on nav+canvas merges).
- ADR-0016 amendment confirmed: mandatory Overview supersedes single-emergent auto-open; cross-referenced in ADR-0016 and ADR-0024.
- Editor scope + object-nav (Archie-5e96) — one sidebar, two labeled scope zones (Exhibit / This object, sticky headers); filmstrip rail = the single object-nav scheme, nav-only, minimizable, [/] keyboard face; +Media/+Map and toasts evicted (homes: Archie-beb6 / Archie-b671).

title: Navigation model: routable views and the overview skip
description:
## Question
W1+W2: what is the navigation model? Should views be routable/addressable (URLs, browser back, deep links, refresh survival) in a dual-target web+Tauri app, and should single-object exhibits still skip the Overview screen (same click lands on different screens today)? Decide the desired behavior, not the mechanism.
closeReason: Resolved: place-addressable navigation. (1) URLs name places only (library / slug=overview / slug+objectId=editor); (2) Overview mandatory, single-object skip removed; (3) every place change pushes history incl. filmstrip switches; (4) unresolvable places degrade to nearest surviving ancestor + notice; (5) launch split: web bare URL=Library Home, desktop restores last place; (6) back restores transient screen state session-only; modals never in history. Full record: docs/adr/0004-place-addressable-navigation.md + CONTEXT.md (Navigation).

title: Routing mechanism for web + Tauri webview
description:
## Question
W1 mechanism: given the decided navigation behavior, how do we implement routable state in a Svelte 5 no-router SPA that also runs inside a Tauri webview? Survey options (hash routing, history API, a router lib, Tauri deep-link plugin), check Prior Art dir, produce a recommendation doc.
closeReason: Resolved: hash routing, hand-rolled over pure apps/studio/src/place.ts, no router dep. Static-host (GH Pages, no rewrites) + base-path /studio/ + Tauri webview: a History-API deep link 404s on refresh on every target; a # fragment reaches no server and runs one code path everywhere. Grammar deliberately reuses the archie-viewer hash cite-ladder (ADR-0021: #/{slug}, #/{slug}/o/{id}) with degrade-upward semantics — Studio and viewer share one address vocabulary. Full rationale docs/research/routing-mechanism.md. Merged to main f8fc422.

title: One save vocabulary
description:
## Question
W5+W19: reconcile the save concepts into one model: autosave vs the Save button vs Saved-check indicator (editor) vs Save-to-disk (library project bar) vs dirty dot vs writer-lock banner. What is THE save state model and its one prominent indicator?
closeReason: Resolved: one safety-state save model. (1) Single end-to-end indicator over both stages (session→store autosave, store→disk mirror); Saved only when both clean. (2) Editor Save button removed; ⌘S = universal flush-now; indicator IS the control when action needed; library bar save buttons collapse into same pattern. (3) One shared component, same header slot at every place; states Failed > Action needed > Saving > Saved; stale file binding + unbound-with-real-work = Action needed (gentle, never for untouched seed content). (4) 'Save' names exactly one act: completing the stage that can't auto-complete. Writer-lock banner explicitly NOT a safety state. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md → Persistence. No ADR (reversible, unsurprising).

title: One affordance for details editing
description:
## Question
W3: DetailsEditor is reached via 3 different affordances (info-chip, pencil, accordion Detail panel). Pick one icon/entry convention for edit-details across library, overview, and editor.
closeReason: Resolved: one labeled 'Details' affordance everywhere — the word Details, ✎ pencil iconography where space is tight (tooltip 'Details'), opening the details surface at that thing's level. ⓘ retired (it promises read-only info; these entries open an editor). Per-item pencils on cards/plates/rows KEPT as entry points (batch-tidy workflow) but with identical presentation — one affordance in several places, not three affordances. Editor sidebar 'Detail' panel keeps its place in the This-object zone (Archie-5e96) and adopts the same label ('Details'). Copy standardization rides the product-copy pass.

title: New-exhibit create/import surface
description:
## Question
W6: the first-run flow crams 3 ingestion paths (title, media folder, IIIF via window.prompt) into one grid cell. Prototype a proper create/import surface with validation and preview. Use /prototype.
closeReason: Resolved via prototype (prototypes/create-surface, both variants Playwright-verified): VARIANT A — one scrimmed 'New exhibit' dialog, three paths as in-surface expanding cards (Start empty / From a media folder / From a IIIF link), single-scrim compliant; B's best trait grafted: page-level folder drop opens the dialog pre-populated. IIIF validation auto-starts on paste (debounced; plain-language errors lifted from ManifestImportError). Text-first paths — no new bare glyphs (W18 discipline); decorative marks allowed, meaning never rides on them. Subfolder grouping = progressive disclosure: only when the folder contains media subfolders, offer 'one exhibit from everything / one per subfolder (n)'. Surface built scope-parameterizable ('into exhibit X') but add-to-existing is Archie-beb6's decision. Replaces the grid-cell trio incl. window.prompt IIIF (W6).

title: Library home layout: project bar, search, templates
description:
## Question
W5+W7+W8: with the save model decided, redesign the library home top: where does storage/project state live (not dominating the primary bar), how does search stay unambiguous across the Exhibits/All-images toggle, and how are Example templates separated from user exhibits?
closeReason: Resolved: (1) SafetyState relocates from project bar to the LIBRARY HEADER (same-slot rule, consistent with editor+overview mounts); project bar demotes to one quiet line — 'Living in {location} · Open a library… · Close · Recents ▾' — no dots, no save buttons, no bar-scale prominence (W5 dissolved). (2) UNIFIED SEARCH: one box always searches both corpora; lens toggle governs browsing only; a typed query renders both groups labeled 'Exhibits (n) · Media (n)' (filterExhibits/filterImages both already computed); W7's silent scope switch eliminated. (3) EXAMPLES SHELF: user exhibits + New-exhibit lead; labeled Examples section below with the playground contract stated at shelf level ('edits here aren not saved unless you keep a copy'); expanded for zero-own-exhibit users, auto-collapses to header line at >=1 own exhibit; badge + editor playground banner unchanged.

title: Overview canvas mode: keep, kill, or rework
description:
## Question
W9+W12: the pan/zoom tableau fights the reading-order domain model (two orderings visible; drag ambiguity; heavy zoom chrome for ~10 items). Keep canvas mode, kill it in favor of list, or rework it? Also: does the density slider survive at toolbar level?
closeReason: Resolved: keep both overview modes, canvas primary, trim the chrome. (1) Light table stays — code already implements position=reading-order, drag=reorder, guarded under sort/filter (audit W9 core claim CORRECTED, see ledger). (2) Chrome trim: legend + hints first-use-only (auto-hide after first successful drag), zoom cluster collapses to Fit + live %. (3) Density slider removed everywhere; list gets one fixed row height. (4) Canvas/List and library Exhibits/All-images become persisted view preferences (last choice = default); transient-vs-preference split added to CONTEXT.md, amendment noted in ADR-0004. List remains the structured home for future keyboard reorder (a11y ticket).

title: Bulk selection and destructive actions
description:
## Question
W10: Select mode morphs the sort toolbar into bulk actions; Remove sits beside Sort/Size with a two-step confirm as only guard. Where do selection and destructive bulk actions live in the reworked overview?
closeReason: Resolved: dedicated selection bar. Toolbar never morphs (search/sort keep their home). Entering Select (toggle or starting a marquee) slides in a distinct bottom tray: 'N selected · Remove N · Clear · Done'; two-step confirm on Remove retained; bar exists only during selection (appears-when-real idiom); Esc = clear selection then exit mode per dismissal ladder; a11y keyboard range-select (Shift+Arrow, Ctrl+A, Space — docs/research/a11y-interactions.md) binds while active.

title: Where the narrative is edited
description:
## Question
W11: the overview shows the whole-exhibit spine read-only; editing requires entering some object editor. Where SHOULD the narrative be authored - overview, editor, or a dedicated surface?
closeReason: Resolved: uphold ADR-0005 + ADR-0016 §56 — narrative beats stay authored in the object editor (a beat is camera + prose; framing needs the canvas); overview spine stays read-only. W11's real residue (round-trip friction) is fixed by navigation, not a second authoring surface: each overview spine row becomes a beat deep link — editor at the beat's object with the Narrative panel open and scrolled to that section; browser back returns to overview (cheap under ADR-0024 places). No new authoring surface, no ADR needed (nothing amended).

title: Editor scope separation and one object-nav scheme
description:
## Question
W15+W16: exhibit-scope Narrative stacks in the same accordion as object-scope Notes/To-place/Detail with no boundary; and 3 parallel object-nav schemes coexist (rail filmstrip, narrative go-to, reading order). Decide the scope structure of the editor and the single navigation scheme.
closeReason: Resolved: (1) Scope boundary = two labeled zones in ONE sidebar — 'Exhibit — {title}' zone (Narrative panel; ADR-0016 always-present honored) above a visually distinct 'This object — {label}' zone (Notes, To place, Detail); sticky zone headers, object zone re-labels with filmstrip position. Tabs rejected (hides narrative, defeats ADR-0016 discoverability); side-split rejected (right edge reserved for docked note editor). (2) The filmstrip rail is the ONE object-nav scheme; navigation becomes its ONLY job; the rail is MINIMIZABLE (collapsible to a slim strip); keyboard face [ / ] prev-next is the same scheme. Rail sheds non-nav cargo: +Media/+Map relocate (home decided by Add-grammar Archie-beb6), toasts/mode-banners relocate (Editor-chrome Archie-b671). Spine go-tos are beat deep links (Archie-da38), reading order is ordering — neither is a competing scheme.

title: Editor chrome: dock the note editor, un-float the overlays
description:
## Question
W13+W14: floating chrome (readings rail, note popover, banners, toasts) occludes the artifact; the note form has two homes toggled by cryptic pin glyphs. Prototype an editor layout with one docked note editor and minimal canvas occlusion. Use /prototype + interface-design.
closeReason: Resolved via prototype reaction (prototypes/editor-chrome, two variants): (1) Readings = Variant A sidebar panel in This-object zone, VISUALLY SUBORDINATE to Notes — a quiet legend, not a peer workspace; (2) rail default EXPANDED, collapsed state persists as a view preference; (3) note dock RESIZABLE (ResizeDivider idiom), 320px default, min ~280, width persisted; (4) To place folds into Notes as a collapsible badged group 'To place (n)' — absent at n=0, full worklist when expanded; (5) status strip ABSENT when idle — renders only with an active mode/toast, collapses away otherwise. Docked editor replaces the floating popover; canvas carries zero chrome. Implementation: Archie-96im-successor (see impl ticket).

title: One grammar for adding things
description:
## Question
W17: add-verbs are scattered (+Media/+Map in rail, Box/Outline/Whole in Notes, Add-a-section in Narrative, Add-media plate in overview) with different placement and grammar. Define one add model across surfaces, given the decided create surface and editor structure.
closeReason: Resolved: the two-kind grammar. (1) BRINGING SOMETHING IN = the one chooser: every add-media affordance (overview Add-media plate, single '+ Add media' in the editor object-zone header) opens the 8482 dialog scoped 'into this exhibit'; Map becomes a fourth path card inside it (AddMapModal retired as a standalone surface — in-surface expansion, single-scrim); separate +Media/+Map buttons die (answers chrome-builder's parked TODO). (2) MAKING SOMETHING HERE = a gesture from its panel: Box/Outline/Whole stay in Notes, Add-a-section stays in Narrative, per ADR-0011 gesture-initiated creation. One-sentence grammar recorded in close + CONTEXT-worthy if it recurs.

title: Label the load-bearing glyphs
description:
## Question
W18: bare glyphs carry load-bearing meaning (drag grip, pin, outline/box/whole, cite, cmd-K). For the chrome that survives the editor redesign, write labels/tooltips/affordance text. Use product-copy skill.

title: Modality rules: cite-flow nesting and surface stacking
description:
## Question
W4+W20: modal-over-modal in the cite flow (CmdK opens MediaPicker); drawers+modals+popovers+banners stack with undefined focus/escape/z-priority. Define the modality rules: what may stack, what must replace, how each dismisses.
closeReason: Resolved: (1) Single-scrim invariant — at most one scrimmed surface ever; opening from inside one REPLACES it; W20 fix: MediaPicker becomes the image tab inside CmdK (one surface, internal tabs, one Esc); drawers are scrimmed surfaces (drawer-vs-dialog is presentational only). (2) Strict dismissal contract: Esc ladder = topmost floater then the scrimmed surface; scrim-click = Esc; focus trapped + returned to opener; NO close-confirmations anywhere (autosave payoff; destructive-act confirms untouched); toasts/banners outside the ladder. Publish wizard mid-auth close = clean cancel, resumable — warn-or-not delegated to Archie-7d9b. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md → Surfaces. Modals never in history per ADR-0024.

title: Publish flow continuity
description:
## Question
W21: publish is a 3-surface chain (button, dialog, wizard) that exits the app for device-code auth; failure recovery lands outside the app. Redesign for continuity - fewer hops, in-app recovery.
closeReason: Resolved: (1) PublishDialog + Publish wizard merge into ONE scrimmed surface — destination choice (web/local/zip) is step 1, internal steps with in-surface back (modality contract). (2) Esc mid-device-code-auth = clean cancel, SESSION-RESUMABLE, no warning: the machine keeps the pending device code (valid ~15min); reopening Publish resumes at the same waiting state/code; expired code → plain start-again sentence. Consistent with no-close-confirmations (fix the cost, not the exit). AUDIT CORRECTION recorded in ledger: in-surface retry/progress already existed; device-code auth + Pages-enable fallback are inherent to the serverless architecture, not flaws. Local/zip destinations unchanged.

title: Help and onboarding surface
description:
## Question

title: linearHead ignores mergeParents: resolved notes permanently uneditable; classifyLogical throws on logs with past resolutions
description:
## Bug (proven by characterization, ticket Archie-697c / B2)

linearHead (spine/log.ts:46-48) builds its referenced-set from `.parent` only, but resolveConflict (spine/merge.ts:251-252) records non-primary heads in `mergeParents`. After a resolution: headsOf correctly = 1 head, but linearHead still counts {merge node, non-primary head} = plural and THROWS. Consequences (both pinned by tests labelled "(OQ-1 pin, BUG)" in spine/merge-contract.test.ts, C4 ~l171 and C11 ~l332): (1) a resolved note is permanently uneditable/undeletable via appendEdit/appendDelete/session.edit; (2) classifyLogical throws on any log containing a past resolution — the async-zip merge path breaks post-resolve.

Fix shape (per B2 report): one-line — share parentsOf (mergeParents-aware, merge.ts:106-111) with linearHead. BEHAVIOR CHANGE: flip the two OQ-1-pin tests deliberately (they are labelled for exactly this), re-derive C4/C11 clauses in MERGE-CONTRACT.md, full spine suite must stay green otherwise.

Blocks: MergeReview flow (Archie-d71c) — resolve-then-edit is its immediate next action; spine gate (Archie-494c) — OQ-1 must be fixed before write primitives are reused for authored structure. See MERGE-CONTRACT.md "Open questions" for OQ-2..6 (recorded, lower stakes).
closeReason: FIXED, merged. parentsOf (primary parent + mergeParents) moved from merge.ts to log.ts as the ONE shared referenced-set builder; linearHead uses it — structural agreement with headsOf (they build the same set over the same filter; cannot disagree on any log). 2 pin-tests flipped as designed, 3 new regressions (resolve->edit, resolve->delete, post-resolution classify), MERGE-CONTRACT C4/C11 re-derived + OQ-1 marked resolved. 847/847 render-core, studio 342, archie-viewer 108, viewer 94, typecheck clean. Sibling sweep: linearHead was the only wrong parent-only build (lineage/withProvLink/deserialize verified deliberate). d71c inherits: resolved notes fully editable; resolve-live-then-delete sanctioned; resolved libraries round-trip the async-zip path.

title: Probe: sections as rev-logged structure records (the structure-DAG slice)
description:
## Question

Do the six spine-gate decisions (Archie-494c) compose on a REAL unit type without breaking the persistence/projection shape? Slice = SECTIONS (they exercise every decided semantic: order key, object references, parent-child with notes, exhibit scoping).

KILL CRITERION (fixed before code): if projecting exhibit structure from per-record rev-logs cannot round-trip the seed library working->publish->open losslessly, OR degrades Studio structure-edit interactivity below the Issue-11-era perf bars, PARK and rethink the persistence shape.

Riskiest assumptions: (A1) log/merge/heads primitives generalize over a record interface with ZERO annotation-behavior change (merge-contract suite 847/847 stays green untouched); (A2) seed round-trip lossless; (A3) projection perf within bars; (A4) child-carried fractional order key yields stable, deterministic order under concurrent edit + resolve.

Flag archie.structureRevlog, branch probe/structure-revlog, ledger ledgers/PROBE-structure-revlog.md (assumption|riskiest?|probe|result|verdict). Probe shortcuts allowed everywhere the assumptions are not; slice never wires into apps by default. On pursue: hands to a build-plan session -> implementer agents (user-ordered 2026-07-18).
